motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Panel arrival and switch knob easing.

motion.name: panel-arrival
motion.purpose: Translate from 6px below and opacity .8 to the resting position and opacity 1.

motion.name: switch-knob
motion.purpose: Move the paper knob 14px for On.

motion.name: hour-progress
motion.purpose: Left-origin scaleX updates hour progression without changing layout width.

motion.name: scene-crossfade
motion.purpose: Linear canvas blend between paintings while motion is on.

motion.name: listening-session
motion.purpose: Eighteen arrangements and six chapters shape the score. Next changes the score without advancing the independent environment clock; Pause holds both clocks.

motion.name: environment-time
motion.purpose: Independent environment time controls light, weather and events. Still freezes lighting, water, weather and captions together while audio and environment time continue; arrival in a new place/date resets the environment while the old song finishes.

motion.name: scene-evening
motion.purpose: All four places have matched arrival and evening paintings with distinct sky, distance, foreground and water timing. The coastal sun and its reflection fade together; local lamps and captions follow each scene's arc, with later lantern light and fireflies in the meadow. After hours holds the final lighting. A failed evening load preserves the original painting with scene-specific retry; procedural evening grades are a fallback.

motion.name: scene-composite
motion.purpose: Retain one full-size lighting composite for the active place and rebuild it at most once per interval; water reflections sample that same composite. Load each arrival/evening pair when its place is visited, caching at most four arrival and four evening images.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Start still, react to preference changes, remove CSS transitions and animations; audio remains independent.

narrative.overview:
Motes is an illustrated place to settle into with warm, jazzy lofi. A shelter holding an amber mote welcomes the listener; a toasted-brown radio and cream settings make the interface feel familiar and comfortable. The paintings remain the focus.

Four authored places establish the world: Neon rain, Golden hour, Last light station and The last chapter. Each has matched arrival and evening paintings. Daily editions change the chosen place, atmosphere and musical arrangement. They do not create a new painting each day.
keyCharacteristics: Full-viewport paintings with moving water, weather, light and small distant events.
An original shelter-and-mote logo, warm brown radio, amber playback and cream settings.
Clear labelled controls on desktop and phone, opt-in music and independent scene motion.
dos: Do keep the illustrated, cosy videogame character and make every scene beautiful when still.
Do preserve the original shelter-and-mote identity, warm brown radio, amber listening action and cream settings.
Do retain visible action labels on phones, readable contrast and useful keyboard focus.
Do distinguish the four authored places and their paired lighting states from their daily atmospheric and musical editions.
donts: Don't reintroduce organisms, names/stats, experiments, an Explore interface or dashboard density.
Don't start sound without a listening action or make ambient scene motion depend on music.
Don't replace the paintings with realistic rendering or toy-like procedural scenery.
